title: Firstfruits of crops and flocks to the priests
english: The law orders [[firstfruits of all crops and flocks to be brought to the priests >> Bible:Numbers 18:8-19]]. What is given to priests is offered to God. No one may lawfully use the fruits until firstfruits are brought.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).

title: Letter and spirit of offering
english: Disciples of the new covenant do well to keep this law in due measure; some commands of the letter are kept with the Spirit. Alms and gifts for the poor honor Christ’s priesthood.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).

title: Prayer as firstfruits to the true High Priest
english: Whoever with a pure mind pours out prayers and thanksgivings has, through the angel of the altar, offered the firstfruits of his sacrifice to the great High Priest, Christ Jesus, to whom be glory forever. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
